LanguageData.RSMF.Business.Tutorial.StartBusinessRest: Designate an indoor store area, and place within it a cash register, a restaurant reception and serving counter, a stove, and at least one set of tables and chairs.

Enter the Restaurant Settings interface in Store Management, and edit the dishes you want to put on the menu.\nPlace a storage rack in this indoor store area and stock it with the required ingredients, and you're ready to open for business.
